testCases.title: Standard user adds a single product to cart and cart count increments to 1
testCases.description: Verify that when a standard user adds one product to the cart, the cart badge count updates to 1.
testCases.preconditions: Standard user is logged in and on the products page.
steps: 1. Navigate to the products listing page.
2. Click the 'Add to cart' button on any single product.
3. Observe the cart icon badge in the top-right navigation.
testCases.expectedResult: Cart badge displays the count '1'. The clicked product's button changes to 'Remove'.

dataConditions.product: any available product on the listing page

testCases.title: Standard user adds multiple products to cart and cart count matches items added
testCases.description: Verify that adding N products to the cart results in the cart badge showing the count N.
testCases.preconditions: Standard user is logged in and on the products page. Cart is empty.
steps: 1. Navigate to the products listing page.
2. Click 'Add to cart' on the first product.
3. Click 'Add to cart' on the second product.
4. Click 'Add to cart' on the third product.
5. Observe the cart icon badge count.
testCases.expectedResult: Cart badge displays '3'. Each added product's button changes to 'Remove'.

testCases.title: Standard user removes a single product from cart and cart count decrements by 1
testCases.description: Verify that removing one product from the cart reduces the cart badge count by 1.
testCases.preconditions: Standard user is logged in. Two products have been added to the cart (cart count = 2).
steps: 1. Navigate to the products listing page.
2. Add two products to the cart.
3. Click the 'Remove' button on one of the added products.
4. Observe the cart icon badge count.
testCases.expectedResult: Cart badge decrements from 2 to 1. The removed product's button reverts to 'Add to cart'.

testCases.title: Standard user removes multiple products from cart and count reduces accordingly
testCases.description: Verify that removing multiple products reduces the cart badge count by the exact number of removed items.
testCases.preconditions: Standard user is logged in. Three products have been added to the cart (cart count = 3).
steps: 1. Navigate to the products listing page.
2. Add three products to the cart.
3. Click 'Remove' on the first added product.
4. Observe cart count is now 2.
5. Click 'Remove' on the second added product.
6. Observe cart count is now 1.
testCases.expectedResult: Cart badge decrements to 2 after first removal, then to 1 after second removal. Removed products revert to 'Add to cart'.

testCases.title: Standard user removes all products from cart and cart badge disappears
testCases.description: Verify that removing all products from the cart results in no cart badge (or badge showing 0).
testCases.preconditions: Standard user is logged in. Two products have been added to the cart.
steps: 1. Navigate to the products listing page.
2. Add two products to the cart (cart count = 2).
3. Click 'Remove' on the first product.
4. Click 'Remove' on the second product.
5. Observe the cart icon.
testCases.expectedResult: Cart badge is no longer visible (or shows 0). Both product buttons revert to 'Add to cart'.

testCases.title: Standard user clicks a product name and is redirected to the product detail page
testCases.description: Verify that clicking a product name navigates the standard user to the correct product detail page.
testCases.preconditions: Standard user is logged in and on the products listing page.
steps: 1. Navigate to the products listing page.
2. Note the name of the first visible product.
3. Click the product name link.
4. Observe the resulting page.
testCases.expectedResult: User is redirected to the product detail page. The page title or heading matches the clicked product name. The product image corresponds to the selected product.

testCases.title: Standard user clicks cart icon with 0 items and navigates to cart page
testCases.description: Verify that the cart icon is clickable even when empty, and navigates to the cart page.
testCases.preconditions: Standard user is logged in. Cart is empty (no items added).
steps: 1. Navigate to the products listing page.
2. Confirm no items have been added to the cart (badge absent).
3. Click the cart icon in the top navigation.
testCases.expectedResult: User is navigated to the cart page. The cart page shows an empty cart message.

testCases.title: Standard user clicks cart icon with one item and navigates to cart page
testCases.description: Verify that the cart icon is clickable with one item in the cart and navigates to the cart page.
testCases.preconditions: Standard user is logged in and has added exactly one item to the cart.
steps: 1. Navigate to the products listing page.
2. Add one product to the cart.
3. Click the cart icon in the top navigation.
testCases.expectedResult: User is navigated to the cart page. The cart page shows exactly the one added product.

testCases.title: Standard user clicks cart icon with multiple items and navigates to cart page
testCases.description: Verify that the cart icon is clickable with multiple items and navigates to the cart page showing all added items.
testCases.preconditions: Standard user is logged in and has added multiple items to the cart.
steps: 1. Navigate to the products listing page.
2. Add three products to the cart.
3. Click the cart icon in the top navigation.
testCases.expectedResult: User is navigated to the cart page. The cart page shows all three added products.

testCases.title: Problem user remove button does not reduce the cart quantity
testCases.description: Verify that for the problem_user, clicking 'Remove' on a product does not decrement the cart badge count — a known defect.
testCases.preconditions: Problem user is logged in. One or more products have been added to the cart.
steps: 1. Log in as problem_user.
2. Navigate to the products listing page.
3. Add two products to the cart (observe cart count = 2).
4. Click the 'Remove' button on one of the added products.
5. Observe the cart badge count.
testCases.expectedResult: Cart badge count does NOT decrement (remains at 2). This is the known defective behaviour for problem_user — removal has no effect on cart count.

testCases.title: Problem user sees all product images as the same image across all listings
testCases.description: Verify that all products on the listing page display the same image for problem_user.
testCases.preconditions: Problem user is logged in and on the products listing page.
steps: 1. Log in as problem_user.
2. Navigate to the products listing page.
3. Collect the `src` attribute of the image element for each listed product.
4. Compare all collected image src values.
testCases.expectedResult: All product images share the same `src` URL — images are identical across all product cards.

testCases.title: Problem user clicking a product link sees an incorrect image on the detail page
testCases.description: Verify that for problem_user, the product detail page displays a different (incorrect) image rather than the actual product image.
testCases.preconditions: Problem user is logged in and on the products listing page.
steps: 1. Log in as problem_user.
2. Navigate to the products listing page.
3. Note the product title for one product.
4. Click the product name link for that product.
5. On the detail page, capture the `src` attribute of the product image.
6. Compare with the expected image src for the correct product.
testCases.expectedResult: The product detail page shows an image that does NOT correspond to the selected product. Image src differs from what a standard_user would see for the same product.

testCases.title: Standard user cart count remains consistent after navigating away and returning to the products page
testCases.description: Edge case — verify that the cart count persists correctly when the user navigates to another page and returns to the products listing.
testCases.preconditions: Standard user is logged in. Cart is empty.
steps: 1. Navigate to the products listing page.
2. Add two products to the cart (badge shows 2).
3. Click the cart icon to navigate to the cart page.
4. Click 'Continue Shopping' or navigate back to the products listing page.
5. Observe the cart badge count on the products page.
testCases.expectedResult: Cart badge still shows '2'. Previously added products still display 'Remove' buttons.
